include.spryker-shop/shop-ui: ShopUi provides the page layouts and molecules the templates extend.
include.spryker/money: The Back Office order block and the Yves consent and Connected apps templates format the order limit with the Twig money filter, which no PHP class references.
include.spryker/permission: The company role permission scope filter grants a scope only when a role holds its permission key, so the feature requires the permission module.
include.spryker/sales: spy_agentic_commerce_sales_order references spy_sales_order by a foreign key, so the feature schema requires the sales module.
include.spryker/transfer: Provides transfer objects definition with strict types.

exclude.spryker/merchant: This is an optional dependency: only the merchant allowlist constraint plugins use it, and only a marketplace wires them.
